item.title: Two Sigma deploys 10,000-GPU cluster in new data center
item.description: Two Sigma Investments has deployed a 10,000-GPU cluster in a new data center in New Jersey to train larger forecasting models.

item.title: XTX Markets expands Finnish data center with thousands of new GPUs
item.description: XTX Markets is expanding its data center in Finland with thousands of additional GPUs to support its machine learning research, the company said.

item.title: AMD unveils new FPGA family for data centers
item.description: AMD unveiled a new family of FPGAs aimed at low-latency networking and AI inference in data centers.

item.title: Acme Robotics is hiring FPGA engineers for its new lidar
item.description: Acme Robotics is hiring FPGA engineers with Verilog experience to build the processing pipeline for its new lidar sensor.

item.title: Meta brings new 100,000-GPU cluster online
item.description: Meta said it has brought a new GPU cluster with more than 100,000 GPUs online for training large language models.

item.title: Why a two sigma event is not as rare as you think
item.description: In a normal distribution a two sigma event happens about 5% of the time. A two-sigma move in a stock is therefore not unusual, and statisticians warn against reading too much into it.

item.title: Millennium Falcon Lego set returns with faster build
item.description: The Millennium Falcon Lego set is back, and fans say the new version is faster to build. Retailers expect it to sell out.
